title: Dataset of EEG recordings of pediatric patients with epilepsy based on the 10-20 system
description: Scalp EEG recordings from 30 children and adolescents with focal or generalized epilepsy, acquired with the 10-20 system. The first three hours of sleep EEG were recorded, and 5-minute N3 sleep intervals were extracted and bipolar referenced. An automated, clinically validated detector was used to mark high-frequency oscillations (ripples, 80-250 Hz), which are candidate non-invasive biomarkers of epileptogenicity, so that age effects on ripple rates in pediatric epilepsy can be studied.
methods_description: Sleep EEG was recorded for about 3 hours at the beginning of sleep and stored in EDF format. Sleep stages were identified from sleep annotations, and 5-minute intervals were cut from N3 sleep. Bipolar referencing of all nearest-neighbour channels gave 52 bipolar channels. An automated HFO detector produced event markings with associated features for ripples in the 80-250 Hz band.
